headline: OLED iPad mini may arrive this year, report suggests
summary: Bloomberg reports an OLED iPad mini could launch by October. The iPad mini has been largely unchanged since 2021.
details: Apple may refresh the iPad mini with an OLED display by October, according to a Bloomberg report. This would mark a significant upgrade for the device, which has been largely unchanged since its 2021 overhaul.
The iPad mini received a chip upgrade in 2024, but its design has remained the same. An OLED display could provide a compelling reason for users to upgrade.

The report also mentions that other iPad models are expected to be refreshed in 2027, including the entry-level iPad and iPad Air. The next-gen iPad Air could debut in spring 2027, alongside new iPad Pro and Apple Pencil models.
It's worth noting that the potential price of the OLED iPad mini is unclear, but recent price increases for many Apple devices and rising component costs may result in a higher price point.

headline_marked: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 [[leaked with Exynos chip]] a week before launch
headline: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 leaked with Exynos chip a week before launch
summary: Leaked images and specs for the Galaxy Z Flip 8 show a design similar to the Z Flip 7, with a new Exynos 2600 chip and 45W charging.
details: The Galaxy Z Flip 8 is reportedly getting a processor upgrade to the Samsung Exynos 2600 chip, but it won't be using one of Qualcomm's Snapdragon processors. The new chip is the successor to the Exynos 2500 in the Z Flip 7.

The leaked images and specs, shared by WinFuture, show that the Z Flip 8's design is nearly identical to the current Galaxy Z Flip 7. The displays are also reportedly the same, with a 6.9-inch Dynamic AMOLED display inside and a 4.1-inch Super AMOLED display outside.
The base storage and RAM are also reportedly the same at 256GB and 12GB, respectively. However, the Z Flip 8 will support 45W wired charging, which is a notable upgrade.

Samsung is expected to officially announce the Z Flip 8, and the rest of its new lineup of foldables, at a Galaxy Unpacked event on July 22nd. The phone will be available in a new pale pink color option, as well as 'cream' white and 'graphite' black.
